title: Contract Assistant Professors at Nizam College protest demanding 7th UGC pay scales

ai.summary: Contract Assistant Professors at Nizam College staged a protest demanding implementation of the 7th UGC pay scales as per 2016 norms, service regularisation and job security.

facts.claim: Contract Assistant Professors of Nizam College, Osmania University, staged a protest on Thursday, under the University Teachers’ Association (Contract), demanding implementation of the 7th UGC pay scales as per 2016 norms, service regularisation and job security.
facts.quote: Contract Assistant Professors of Nizam College, Osmania University, staged a protest on Thursday, under the University Teachers’ Association (Contract), demanding implementation of the 7th UGC pay scales as per 2016 norms, service regularisation and job security.

facts.claim: As part of statewide agitation, lecturers attended classes wearing black badges to highlight their grievances.
facts.quote: As part of statewide agitation, lecturers attended classes wearing black badges to highlight their grievances.

facts.claim: Led by its leaders, Thirupathi and Ramdas Nayak, they urged the government to honour the assurances on revised pay scales and job protection.
facts.quote: Led by its leaders, Thirupathi and Ramdas Nayak, they urged the government to honour the assurances on revised pay scales and job protection.

facts.claim: The faculty highlighted stagnant salaries despite years of service and sought fair remuneration, retirement benefits, and security.
facts.quote: The faculty highlighted stagnant salaries despite years of service and sought fair remuneration, retirement benefits, and security.
